nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Tình huống khẩn · bài tự soạn
kind: Hội thoại ba người bạn, một người chóng mặt
L: I don't feel well. I'm feeling really dizzy.
Sit down here. You look very pale.
Here, drink some water. I've got a bottle in my bag.
Only a coffee this morning. I skipped lunch.
That might be why. Take slow, deep breaths.
I feel a bit sick. Maybe I should go home.
We'll walk you home. If you feel worse, we'll call an ambulance.
Let's go slowly. Hold my arm.

exq.why: “drink some water. I've got a bottle” = Sara đưa nước.
“Only a coffee this morning. I skipped lunch.” = chỉ uống một ly cà phê.

exq.q: How do the friends help Mia get home?
exq.why: “We'll walk you home.” = đưa cậu về nhà bằng cách đi bộ cùng.

exq.q: When will they call an ambulance?
exq.why: “If you feel worse, we'll call an ambulance.” = nếu tệ hơn thì gọi.
